# pyAMS2SharedMemory
Python library for accessing Automobilista 2's Shared Memory Interface.

## Acknowledgement
This library is based on:
- Official "AMS2 SharedMemoryExampleApp" (based on SMS PCARS2 sample), found in game's `Support\SharedMemory` folder.
- pyACCSharedMemory: https://github.com/TinyPedal/pyACCSharedMemory
